skill_name: Describe how racism can affect a person's wellbeing.
workflow: Racism can have a devastating ocncusslion on the mental and emotional health of an individual. Experiences of racism can cause stress, depression, anxiety, low self-esteem, and feelings of isolation. Research indicates that racism and discrimination can lead to physical harm as well, with people of color are more likely to suffer from higher rates of chronic illnesses such as hypertension, diabetes, and heart disease.
